Source integrity. Every role is pulled from the named company's own applicant-tracking feed. View opens on the employer domain — not a job board.
How this search works

The job boards themselves, paginated as categories rather than as a handful of keyword searches. Reed's solicitor, lawyer and counsel listings (about five thousand solicitor vacancies live at any time), Totaljobs' legal category, and the whole TotallyLegal board. Adzuna's API is queried too when a key is set, which is the route that reaches Reed, CV-Library, Jobsite and hundreds of employer sites the other three cannot see. Hits are filtered to a legal-function title, recruiter-consultant ads are dropped, then de-duplicated by URL and by employer plus title plus town so the same role carried by three boards appears once. Roles at employers the In-house tab already covers are dropped. This is the widest route on the board. Fit score (0 to 100) = title lane (IP, brand, China) + level (NQ to mid) + employer/sector prior, then a light Python JD scan (httpx + BeautifulSoup, no browser) of roles scoring ≥65 to pull PQE / IP-China signals and re-rank. Three shortlist lanes: lane match, generic title at priority employers, on-ramp junior/NQ. A red NEW badge means first seen today. Ex jobs tab = dropped off. Filters narrow the full list.

Three-lane shortlist. Fit = title lane (IP/brand/China) + level (NQ to mid) + employer/sector prior + optional JD-body signals (PQE, moat words) on a selective subset of roles. Generic "Legal Counsel" at priority employers is its own panel so it is not buried by keyword hits. A red new badge marks roles first seen today (no separate new section). Ex-jobs that dropped off live under the Ex jobs tab. Verify PQE in the JD before applying. UK-wide, not London-only. Enrich: {'selected': 400, 'fetched': 0, 'cache_hits': 307, 'failed': 93, 'fit_min': 65, 'limit': 400}.
Her lane. Title or JD body signals IP, brand, trade mark, China, Mandarin, or cross-border.
